Implementation guide

# FDG Construction Management Professional Toolkit — Philippines Edition
Version 1.0.0-rc.1 | Original FDG templates | Review candidate

## Start in 20 minutes
1. Open **FDG-CMT-PH-Worked-Example.xlsx** first. Every populated entry is synthetic. Set Excel calculation to Automatic and recalculate.
2. Open **FDG-CMT-PH-Blank.xlsx**, save a private project copy and complete Setup. Use a unique project ID, an as-of date and an inclusive reporting start/end date. Name the responsible preparer, actual reviewer, issue revision and evidence custodian.
3. Complete Kickoff: confirm scope, contract documents, roles, review authority, reporting cycle, approved baseline, document numbering, evidence custody and escalation route. Add one action per row, with owner and due date.
4. In WBS enter unique IDs, activities, units, approved baseline quantities and explicit weights totaling 100%. Enter planned cumulative fractions for the selected as-of date, with a source reference. Percent inputs use Excel percentages (60%, not 60). Do not add quantities with unlike units. This edition uses a manual approved plan snapshot; it does not calculate a critical path or time-phased S-curve.
5. Capture Daily events once using stable event IDs. Record the event date, project/WBS, unit, reported quantity, preparer and source. Reported quantity is an observation; accepted quantity is a separately reviewed value.
6. For accepted events, record the actual evidence reference, reviewer, review date and accepted quantity. Select Accepted only after the project's real approval process. A dropdown, typed name or workbook formula is not a signature or authorization control.
7. Review Dashboard warnings and source rows, then read Report. Set a week or month in Setup to use the same period-report template. Combine the report with the printable narrative form for accomplishments, blockers, decisions and next-period commitments.
8. Before issuing, verify against original records, resolve conflicts, have the authorized person review, record the revision in History and preserve an immutable issued copy in your private document system.

## Files and working method
- Two XLSX workbooks: 17 sheets each; 13 coordinated registers plus Start, Setup, Dashboard and Report.
- csv/blank: portable input headers; csv/sample: matching synthetic records. CSV files contain inputs only, not formulas, formatting or dropdowns.
- sample-project.json: machine-readable synthetic fixture.
- forms.html: standalone printable forms. Open in a browser, type into the fields, then print/save PDF. It has no persistence: typed contents disappear on reload. Preserve the completed output before closing. Long text fields expand; inspect print preview and add continuation pages when needed.
- DATA_DICTIONARY.md and schema/toolkit-schema.json: stable migration contract.
- MANIFEST.json: SHA-256 and byte sizes for distributed payloads, excluding itself.
- IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md: this guide. Build source and validation evidence are maintained alongside the distribution in GitHub.

Use a single designated editor per working copy. Do not email competing editable masters. When simultaneous edits occur, retain both versions, flag Conflict - Review Required, compare records by stable ID and revision, and have the owner reconcile in History. There is no automatic merge or access enforcement.

| Sheet | Operating use | Review evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Kickoff | Startup requirements and assigned actions | Meeting/decision reference and actual review |

| Submittals | Submitted document and document revision | Reviewer response; preserve superseded versions |
| Issues | Issues, constraints and delays | Facts, impact basis, owner and next action; no automatic entitlement |
| QAQC | WIR/MIR/NCR/inspection status | Project-specific method, acceptance criterion, observation and qualified review |
| Changes | Notices and potential variations | Authorization reference; cost/time remain unknown until assessed |
| Billing | Progress billing evidence index | Independent billable authority, billing and payment references |
| Punch | Location/trade defects and corrective work | Closure evidence and actual verification |
| Turnover | O&M, as-built, test, training, warranty and handover deliverables | Named receiver, blockers and acceptance evidence |
| Evidence | Reference-to-record locator and custody | Origin, capture date, access class and verification state |
| History | Revision and decision trail | Reason, actor, prior/new revision and decision/evidence reference |

The workbook does not populate technical acceptance criteria or legal forms. Adapt to the executed contract and applicable Philippine requirements using qualified review. No prescribed tax, retention, withholding, labor, safety or design rates are embedded. PHP is a display convention, not a tax computation.

## Calculation rules
Each register has **200 prepared rows (7–206)**. Pale amber cells are inputs; pale green cells are calculated. Report and Dashboard are calculated outputs. Extend every formula, validation, table and referenced range together before exceeding capacity; the generator/schema are the safer route for a larger edition.

Accepted cumulative quantity includes only matching project/WBS/unit events with unique event IDs, nonnegative reported and accepted numbers, accepted quantity no greater than reported, Accepted state, nonblank evidence/reviewer, valid event/review dates and both dates at or before the as-of date. Evidence references are recorded, not automatically authenticated or dereferenced.

Weighted actual = sum of (accepted cumulative quantity / approved baseline quantity) × approved WBS weight. Every active WBS needs a positive baseline, valid unique ID, matching project, explicit plan and weight, unit and source. Weights must total 100%. Every active WBS needs eligible accepted data before a complete actual percentage is shown. If known work is zero, record a reviewed zero event rather than inventing a zero for an unknown activity. The workbook does not cap overrun progress at 100%; investigate an overrun against the baseline.

Report groups by WBS and unit. Its reported column totals nonnegative reported inputs for matching project/WBS/unit and dates, excluding duplicate event IDs; inspect Daily unit/quantity warnings before issuing. Accepted period quantities use the stricter eligibility rule. Period totals may be zero when no matching events exist; that is no recorded event in the interval, not proof of zero work or approval. Cumulative unknowns remain blank, and incomplete Dashboard progress displays n.a. Reversed intervals produce blank period results.

RFI overdue is a due date earlier than the as-of date with a populated ID and state other than Accepted/Rejected. Other open/pending counts are administrative status counts, not validated closure or payment. Dashboard warnings count failing checks, so one row may contribute several warnings.

**Reported ≠ accepted ≠ billable ≠ billed ≠ paid.** Billing fields are independent manual records. Do not infer a payment from accepted progress. Reconcile each claim to its authority, approved measure, contract rate, issued billing record and actual settlement. This toolkit is not a statutory invoice, accounting ledger or entitlement determination.

## Worked example checks
Project DEMO-PH-001; as-of 2026-10-16; interval 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-16.
- Concrete: baseline 100 m3; weight 60%; accepted 45 m3; planned fraction 50%.
- Pipe: baseline 200 m; weight 40%; accepted 40 m; planned fraction 25%.
- Accepted weighted progress **35%**; planned **40%**; variance **−5 percentage points**.
- Period concrete reported/accepted **50 / 45 m3**; pipe **60 / 40 m**.
- A future event and an unreviewed accepted quantity are excluded from accepted progress.
- One overdue RFI, open issue, open punch and pending turnover.
- Billable/billed/paid quantities are deliberately unknown. All evidence locators are illustrative and resolve to no real client records.

## Evidence, privacy and backup
Use durable references to your private approved document store. Keep original photos, site reports, review responses and issued revisions there; the index is not a substitute for originals. Record a checksum when your document-control process requires it. Do not paste credentials, public sharing tokens, personal data or client files into this public repository.

At the end of each reporting cycle save a dated working backup, export input registers and preserve the issued report separately. Verify that backups reopen and references remain accessible. Limit access in the actual file/document system. Workbook colors and status fields provide no confidentiality or authorization.

## Migration and continuity
Keep IDs as text and preserve them across CSV exports, revised copies and future platform imports. Use ISO dates yyyy-mm-dd, decimal numeric quantities, explicit units and PHP cost fields. Blank means unknown/not entered; zero is a measured value. Do not change units within a WBS. Export each sheet to its own UTF-8 CSV; retain the schema version and project ID. CSV import is a manual mapping step, not a sync feature. Preserve source references, revisions and evidence locators. Future software must distinguish observations, review decisions, billable records and settlements and must retain history.

To recover after interruption: read CURRENT_HANDOVER.md and evidence/VALIDATION.md in the repository. Reuse the committed generator and schema. Re-run failed/pending checks only after inspecting the current source; do not recreate the product from a chat summary.

## Validation and release boundary
Artifact-tool formula tests and XLSX export/reimport checks are recorded in evidence/VALIDATION.md. Native Microsoft Excel/LibreOffice, actual printer output, real-user acceptance and independent cross-provider review are not established by those tests. Recalculate and confirm the worked-example numbers in the target spreadsheet application before operational issue. Status: review candidate, not a claim of regulatory approval, professional certification or commercial launch.

## Canonical basis
The pinned source-reading receipts and requirement mapping are in evidence/source-review.json and the repository EXECUTION_PACKAGE.md. Source baseline: guinoome/fdg-knowledge-repository commit 91c6fc7346ace8dbf2f7ec86880c6e4b24c2289b, FPJIS First Payout Commercial Validation Blueprints (all21 documents), FEIS-CM-0100 and FEIS-DCKL-0000/0001. These establish the toolkit-first product boundary and staged path to later platforms. Real construction rules and contract-specific acceptance still require project evidence.

Data dictionary and migration

# Data dictionary and migration mapping

FDG-CMT-PH 1.0.0-rc.1. One project per workbook. IDs are stable text; dates are ISO yyyy-mm-dd; quantities carry the WBS unit. No mixed-unit aggregation. Currency fields are PHP. Blank means unknown/not entered; zero is a numeric observation.

Input CSV columns match the workbook field order with computed columns removed. Blank CSVs contain only headers. Sample CSVs contain synthetic inputs. No automatic CSV import, sync or conflict merge exists. Do not paste untrusted formula-prefixed text into Excel; import identifiers as text. Maintain record IDs and source references through future migrations.

Common states: Draft, Submitted, In Review, Accepted, Rejected, Superseded, Conflict - Review Required. Issues/Punch: Open, In Progress, Ready for Verification, Closed, Conflict - Review Required. Turnover: Pending, Submitted, In Review, Accepted, Conflict - Review Required. Evidence verification is a manual declaration, not authenticated evidence. Required real-world review cannot be enforced in an editable spreadsheet.

## Relationship and review rules

project_id must equal Setup project ID. wbs_id references WBS within the same project. Daily event_id must be unique within project; duplicates are excluded from accepted calculations. Other register IDs must be unique by the document-control process; the workbook does not automatically validate their uniqueness. Evidence references point to Evidence IDs or a private approved source; semicolon-separated references are descriptive and are not an enforced relational link. History target_record_id references an unchanged stable record ID. Records are never silently merged by the toolkit.

Weights and planned_fraction use fractions 0–1. accepted_fraction and weighted values are computed; accepted quantities are not capped at baseline. Review state, reviewer, review date and evidence are separate fields. Billing reported/accepted/billable/billed/paid quantities remain distinct manual facts. QA/QC method and acceptance criteria must be established for the actual project. No technical limits are inferred from a sample.

evidence/VALIDATION.md
# Toolkit validation record

Date: 2026-10-16. Version1.0.0-rc.1. Status: build review candidate; commercial launch and professional acceptance are not claimed.

## Verified execution
- All21 in-memory Artifact Tool calculation/edge tests PASS. Exact cases: calculation-tests.json.
- Blank and sample XLSX exported through RAM named pipes, reimported and recalculated. Blank progress: n.a.; sample accepted35%, planned40%, variance−5 percentage points. Reimport table evidence: xlsx-reimport.json.
- Every one of17 worksheet layouts visually inspected (Start, Dashboard, Setup, Report, all13 registers). Headers, date formats, units, computed/input distinction, synthetic labels and representative long fields reviewed. Report date spacing/header alignment and register wrapping corrected. Final logic-only unit filter change does not alter the inspected sample layout.
- HTML source reviewed: eleven forms, unique section IDs, labeled editable fields, explicit reviewer/revision, A4 print CSS, responsive layout, no scripts/external resources. Browser editing, pagination and physical/PDF printing are NOT yet verified.
- Workbook/package structural checks and ZIP hash round-trip are executed by build/package-toolkit.mjs and saved in package-checks.json. They check worksheets, formula cells, tables, validation, cached Excel errors, macros/links, CSV headers, form structure and every packaged payload checksum.
- GitHub blob/tree publication uses an expected-main SHA lease, preserving unrelated paths. No project files or downloads stored locally. Existing bundled runtime only; no installs.

## Source-to-deliverable coverage
| Minimum v1 component | Delivered implementation |
|---|---|
| Startup/Kickoff | Setup, Kickoff; forms: Startup and kickoff |
| Daily Site Progress | Daily, WBS; forms: Daily site progress report |
| Weekly/Monthly Progress | Report interval and Dashboard; forms: Weekly / monthly management report |
| RFI/Submittals | RFI, Submittals; two respective forms |
| Issue/Constraint/Delay | Issues; issue / constraint / delay form |
| QA/QC status | QAQC; inspection form |
| Variation/Change | Changes; variation form |
| Progress Billing Evidence | Billing; billing evidence cover |
| Punch List | Punch; punch item form |
| Turnover/Closeout | Turnover; turnover transmittal |
| Management dashboard | Dashboard linked to source inputs |
| Sample project | Worked-Example.xlsx, sample-project.json, csv/sample |
| Implementation guide | IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md, DATA_DICTIONARY.md |

## Acceptance disposition
TK-AC-01–07,10–12: implemented with documented manual controls and limits. TK-AC-08: formula tests, XLSX export/reimport and package-level structure checks executed; no native application equivalence claim. TK-AC-09: all worksheet layouts inspected; printable HTML source reviewed, actual browser/print rendering pending. This is an honest partial application-level validation gate, not blanket release approval.

## Limitations / release work
1. Microsoft Excel/LibreOffice native application recalculation, dropdown behavior and printing require target-application checks. No native application was exercised in this GitHub-only workflow.
2. Browser forms interaction/print preview and long-content pagination require actual browser/print validation. The form has no autosave.
3. Independent opposite-provider review and real construction-user/qualified domain acceptance remain unverified.
4. Commercial licensing/terms, price/demand/payment validation, sale and launch are outside this authorized build. No commercial readiness conclusion.
5. Editable files do not enforce roles, signatures, approved evidence authenticity, security, multi-editor conflict resolution or contractual entitlement. This is an administrative toolkit, not Construction OS.

## Material risks and controls
Capacity is fixed200 rows/register; extend ranges coherently before more records. Baseline, plan and reviewed quantity source integrity require actual project review. Unknown work does not become zero actual progress. Bad unit/duplicate reported events are excluded; inspect source warnings before issue. Preserve approved baseline and issued snapshots. Manual billing fields require reconciliation to real authority and settlement. No Philippine statutory/tax/design values have been invented.

## Rebuild / rollback
Use the committed source with bundled Node/@oai/artifact-tool/JSZip. Set FDG_NODE_MODULES to the existing dependency folder; pass newline JSON export commands to build/build-toolkit.mjs. Outputs are base64 for direct GitHub blob upload. On Windows FileBlob.save targets an OS named pipe to capture bytes in memory. Build/package-toolkit.mjs accepts an input JSON object of {files:{relativePath:{content,encoding}}}; set FDG_PACKAGE_STDIN=1 to run it from stdin. Never create local artifacts against Francis's storage direction. XLSX ZIP relationship IDs may vary; logic/fixtures are deterministic, exact delivered hashes are in MANIFEST.json.

Rollback only owned project file blobs using a normal follow-up commit; never reset the shared repository or force-push. Preserve source-reading receipts so successor agents do not repeat discovery.

All evidence and approvals in the example are fictional. Operational/native application/user acceptance and commercial licensing/launch remain pending; see evidence/VALIDATION.md. No passwords, internet account or backend is required for the files. Keep real client records private.

# FDG Construction Management Professional Toolkit — Philippines Edition

**v1.0.0-rc.1 built — review candidate.** First planned digital product under FPJIS. All13 minimum toolkit components delivered. Native application/user acceptance and commercial launch remain pending.

## Start here
- [Download complete toolkit ZIP](distribution/FDG-CMT-PH-1.0.0-rc.1.zip)
- [Blank workbook](distribution/FDG-CMT-PH-Blank.xlsx)
- [Worked-example workbook](distribution/FDG-CMT-PH-Worked-Example.xlsx)
- [Implementation guide](distribution/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md)
- [Printable forms](distribution/forms.html) — use a browser on an authorized device; no autosave.
- [Validation and limits](evidence/VALIDATION.md)
- [Current handover / exact next milestone](CURRENT_HANDOVER.md)

Two17-sheet workbooks;13 registers;26 input CSVs;11 printable forms; worked project; schema/dictionary; guide; source and validation evidence. Everything is stored in this GitHub Projects folder. No local project storage was used.

21 calculation/edge checks and79 package/integrity checks passed; all17 worksheet layouts inspected. No macros or external workbook links. Sample accepted35%, planned40%, variance−5 percentage points. This is file-level technical evidence; native spreadsheet/printing, actual browser forms, independent-provider and real construction-user acceptance are not yet verified. See the handover before continuing.

Authorized by Francis's2026-10-16 build request. Source baseline91c6fc7346ace8dbf2f7ec86880c6e4b24c2289b: all21 FPJIS blueprint-package documents plus FEIS-CM-0100 and FEIS-DCKL-0000/0001 read in full; [source receipts](evidence/source-review.json). [Execution scope](EXECUTION_PACKAGE.md) and [manifest](distribution/MANIFEST.json) preserve traceability.

Level1 original downloadable toolkit only; [Construction OS staging](../../fdg-construction-os/README.md) is separate. No sales, outreach, payment, deployment or professional certification is implied. Keep real client copies private. Reuse committed [workbook generator](build/build-toolkit.mjs) and [packager](build/package-toolkit.mjs), rather than rebuilding from a chat.
project/CURRENT_HANDOVER.md
# Toolkit current handover

Updated2026-10-16. Milestone: **v1.0.0-rc.1 downloadable toolkit built and saved on GitHub; target-application/user acceptance pending.** This supersedes earlier implementation checkpoints. Read this first; do not rebuild or repeat the repository-wide review.

## Authority and storage
Repository guinoome/fdg-knowledge-repository, main. Owned folder: Projects/Active/FDG Construction Management Professional Toolkit. GitHub is authoritative; no local project artifacts/checkouts/downloads. Source baseline91c6fc7346ace8dbf2f7ec86880c6e4b24c2289b. Francis explicitly authorized this toolkit build2026-10-16. No sale, outreach, payment or deployment authorized. Preserve unrelated repository work and use an expected-head lease for publication.

## Delivered
- distribution/FDG-CMT-PH-1.0.0-rc.1.zip:39 files, 199420 bytes; SHA256 1322b663adf467b20b0f9b62f955d17c9c5fdcade49464997685aee1c5f07a89.
- Blank and synthetic worked-example XLSX:17 worksheets,13 registers,200 rows each;3415 formula cells,13 tables and10 validation rules in each.
-26 CSVs (13 blank +13 sample),11 printable/editable HTML forms, sample JSON, schema/dictionary, implementation guide, source and validation evidence, manifest.
- Source: build/build-toolkit.mjs and build/package-toolkit.mjs. Reuse these, not a fresh scaffold.
- GitHub project index entry and README provide navigation.

## Evidence
21 Artifact Tool calculation/negative tests PASS. Both XLSX exported, reimported and recalculated; sample35% accepted vs40% planned,−5 percentage points. All17 sample worksheet layouts inspected.79 package/structure/CRC/hash checks PASS. No cached Excel errors, macros or external workbook links. Direct GitHub blob identities verified against in-memory bytes. See evidence/VALIDATION.md, calculation-tests.json, xlsx-reimport.json and package-checks.json. MANIFEST.json hashes payloads and excludes itself. Binary ZIP hash is tracked in evidence/package-checks.json and this handover, not recursively inside the ZIP.

## Exact next milestone — acceptance, not reimplementation
1. Open the existing worked-example XLSX in target Excel/LibreOffice, enable automatic calculation and confirm35%,40%,−5pp, concrete50/45 and pipe60/40. Check dropdowns, save/reopen and report printing. Do this only in an authorized environment that respects Francis's no-local-storage direction.
2. Open existing forms.html, check editable fields at phone/desktop widths and A4 print preview with long text. It has no autosave; preserve output before closing. HTML source/layout CSS was reviewed; actual browser/printing not exercised.
3. Obtain independent opposite-provider review when available and a qualified construction user's scenario acceptance. Record findings and patch only demonstrated defects; regenerate affected outputs and hashes from committed sources.
4. Commercial licensing/terms, demand/price/payment evidence and sale/release decision remain separate, not inferred from technical completion.

## Important decisions / risks
Level1 file toolkit only; full Construction OS and Commercial Validation Workspace remain separate. Reported/accepted/billable/billed/paid are separate. Statuses and typed reviewer names are not actual authorization or signatures. Progress requires complete approved WBS basis,100% weights and eligible accepted inputs. Duplicate event IDs and mismatched units are excluded; inspect warning checks before issue. Blank unknowns remain unavailable; explicit reviewed zero is supported. Single editor/manual review/custody/conflict reconciliation; no automated access control, sync or professional certification. Actual project acceptance criteria/contract rules must be supplied, never copied from synthetic examples.

## Runtime / recovery
Existing bundled Node24.19.0, @oai/artifact-tool and JSZip only. Set FDG_NODE_MODULES to the bundled node_modules. Generator accepts newline JSON stdin commands {"op":"export","mode":"blank"} or sample, and render. FileBlob.save targets Windows RAM named pipes; no disk output. Package source accepts input {files:{path:{content,encoding}}} via stdin with FDG_PACKAGE_STDIN=1. Input CSVs map schema input fields only. XLSX relationship IDs/ZIP metadata may vary; exact current artifacts are preserved by Git hashes. No installations needed. Do not attempt Artifact Tool inside restricted node_repl; use bundled Node for workbook execution. JSZip can run via createRequire in node_repl.

## Knowledge improvement
Keep source-review receipts, schema, executable checks, manifests and this milestone handover together. They prevent repeated discovery and make future platform migration auditable. The remaining work is explicit acceptance, not another broad build.
project/EXECUTION_PACKAGE.md
# Toolkit v1 execution package

Date: 2026-10-16. Source baseline: 91c6fc7346ace8dbf2f7ec86880c6e4b24c2289b. Authorized builder: current Codex agent, by Francis's explicit build request in this chat.

## Scope and acceptance
Deliver one original FDG Level 1 downloadable toolkit with a blank workbook, worked synthetic example, portable CSV templates, printable document forms, implementation guide and evidence. Reuse FEIS-CM-0100 and DCKL fields. Do not implement the Commercial Validation Workspace or full Construction OS.

TK-AC-01: All thirteen portfolio v1 components map to delivered files and worksheets.
TK-AC-02: Stable record/project/WBS IDs, ISO dates, explicit units, revision, owner, evidence and review fields retained.
TK-AC-03: One project profile; daily events feed period reporting and accepted cumulative progress. Different quantities/units are never aggregated.
TK-AC-04: Reported, accepted, billable, billed and paid remain distinct. A form/status field is not authorization or a signature.
TK-AC-05: Blank is unknown. Empty baseline, dates, weights and quantity inputs cannot silently become a valid progress percentage.
TK-AC-06: Dashboard uses source records and fixed as-of date. Report interval is explicit and inclusive.
TK-AC-07: Blank deliverables contain no fabricated client records. Worked example is marked synthetic throughout.
TK-AC-08: Exported workbook reimports with intact formulas/tables/validation; representative changes, zero/missing values, cutoff dates and last prepared row tested.
TK-AC-09: Every worksheet visually reviewed in memory; printable forms include owner/reviewer/revision/limitations.
TK-AC-10: No macros, remote links, credentials, external API/auth/payment/hosting or confidential data.
TK-AC-11: Guide explains workflow, capacity, review, safe backup/versioning, import mapping and future migration.
TK-AC-12: Exact build files, artifact hashes, executed checks, limitations and continuation saved on GitHub.

## Decisions
Workbooks: XLSX blank and separately labeled sample. CSV provides stable field-name interchange. HTML provides printable/editable document forms; no hosted application. Workbook row capacity: 200 per register, explicitly documented. Formula outputs are calculations, never professional or contractual approval. Single-editor file workflow; manual version/custody/review controls, no simulated multi-user authorization.

## Build sequence
1. Source review complete: all 21 FPJIS package Markdown documents plus three FEIS/DCKL documents.
2. Define canonical distribution schema and synthetic example; build deterministic generator.
3. Generate XLSX in RAM, CSV and HTML from same schema; save directly through GitHub.
4. Execute recalculation/negative/export/reimport and visual checks; fix only confirmed scope defects.
5. Publish validation, manifests, guide, entry links and final handover.

## Boundaries and rollback
Owned: this Projects folder only plus additive Projects_Master_Index entry. Other source authorities read-only. No deployment. Rollback by restoring this project's prior Git blobs; never reset the repository. User's GitHub-only storage overrides skill defaults requiring local output directories. Runtime dependencies are existing bundled packages, not installations.

## Independent review
Cross-provider live review is unverified/unavailable in the present connected workflow; no Claude CLI or skills installation will be done on the full local disk. Automated calculation and file-integrity checks will be reported accurately; do not label these cross-provider review or human/domain acceptance.

## Artifact authoring
Spreadsheet skill selected. The artifact package cannot import inside restricted node_repl because node:process is blocked. Use the bundled Node executable to run the same committed generator in memory via an encoded command, export to array buffers and return bytes for GitHub upload. No local project files or node_modules link.
project/build/build-toolkit.mjs
import {createRequire} from 'node:module';
import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
import readline from 'node:readline';
import net from 'node:net';
const require=createRequire((process.env.FDG_NODE_MODULES||process.cwd()+'/node_modules')+'/fdg-toolkit-run.cjs');
const {Workbook,SpreadsheetFile}=await import(pathToFileURL(require.resolve('@oai/artifact-tool')).href);

function dateValue(v,k){return typeof v==='string'&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)&&/date$/.test(k)?new Date(v+'T00:00:00Z'):v;}
function baseSheet(wb,name,title,ncols=8){
 const s=wb.worksheets.add(name);s.showGridLines=false;
 s.getRange('A1:'+col(ncols)+'16').format.font={name:'Arial',size:10,color:'#172A2A'};
 s.getRange('A2').values=[[title]];s.getRange('A2').format.font={name:'Arial',size:15,bold:true,color:'#163F35'};
 s.getRange('A2:'+col(ncols)+'2').format.rowHeight=26;
 s.getRange('A:'+col(ncols)).format.columnWidth=19;
 return s;
}
function set(s,a,v){s.getRange(a).values=[[v]];}
function formula(s,a,v){s.getRange(a).formulas=[[v]];}
function rowFormula(s,c,fn){s.getRange(c+first+':'+c+last).formulas=Array.from({length:N},(_,i)=>[fn(i+first)]);s.getRange(c+first+':'+c+last).format.fill='#EAF1EE';}
function table(wb,d,sample){
 const m=d.fields.length,s=baseSheet(wb,d.sheet,d.title,m);
 s.getRange('A4').values=[[sample?'SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY - replace with a separately saved blank workbook':'Blank template - enter your approved project records']];
 s.getRange('A4').format.font={name:'Arial',size:10,italic:true,color:'#526660'};
 s.getRange('A6:'+col(m)+'6').values=[d.fields.map(label)];
 s.getRange('A6:'+col(m)+'6').format={fill:'#173F35',font:{name:'Arial',size:10,bold:true,color:'#FFFFFF'},wrapText:true,rowHeight:42,verticalAlignment:'center',horizontalAlignment:'center'};
 s.getRange('A7:'+col(m)+last).format.font={name:'Arial',size:10,color:'#172A2A'};
 s.getRange('A7:'+col(m)+last).format.rowHeight=60;
 s.getRange('A7:'+col(m)+last).format.wrapText=true;
 s.getRange('A7:'+col(m)+last).format.verticalAlignment='top';
 s.getRange('A7:'+col(m)+last).format.fill='#FFFBEB';
 s.tables.add('A6:'+col(m)+last,true,'TK_'+d.sheet);
 s.freezePanes.freezeRows(6);s.freezePanes.freezeColumns(2);
 for(let i=0;i<m;i++){const k=d.fields[i],c=col(i+1),r=s.getRange(c+first+':'+c+last);
  if(/date$/.test(k))r.setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd');
  if(/qty|weight|fraction|php|days/.test(k))r.setNumberFormat(/weight|fraction/.test(k)?'0.0%':/php/.test(k)?'"PHP "#,##0.00':'#,##0.00');
  if(/revision/.test(k))r.setNumberFormat('0');
  if(/status$|review_state/.test(k)){r.dataValidation={rule:{type:'list',values:d.sheet==='Issues'||d.sheet==='Punch'?['Open','In Progress','Ready for Verification','Closed','Conflict - Review Required']:d.sheet==='Turnover'?['Pending','Submitted','In Review','Accepted','Conflict - Review Required']:k==='verification_status'?['Unverified','Verified','Missing','Conflict - Review Required','Illustrative - not real evidence']:status}};
   r.conditionalFormats.add('containsText',{text:'Conflict',format:{fill:'#FDE8E7',font:{color:'#9B1C1C',bold:true}}});}
  if(/description|subject|title|criterion|observed_result|change_reason|impact_basis|next_action|item$|locator/.test(k))s.getRange(c+':'+c).format.columnWidth=34;
 }
 if(sample&&synthetic[d.sheet]){const rows=synthetic[d.sheet].map(row=>Array.from({length:m},(_,i)=>dateValue(row[i]??null,d.fields[i])));s.getRange('A7:'+col(m)+(6+rows.length)).values=rows;}
 return s;
}
function makeWorkbook(sample){
 const wb=Workbook.create();
 const start=baseSheet(wb,'Start','FDG Construction Management Professional Toolkit',8);
 const dash=baseSheet(wb,'Dashboard','Project management dashboard',8);
 const report=baseSheet(wb,'Report','Period progress report',12);
 const setup=baseSheet(wb,'Setup','Project profile and report controls',5);
 const sheets={Start:start,Dashboard:dash,Report:report,Setup:setup};
 for(const d of records)sheets[d.sheet]=table(wb,d,sample);
 const guides=[
 ['Edition','Philippines Edition / v1.0.0-rc.1'],
 ['Use','Save a private copy before entering real project records.'],
 ['1 Setup','Enter project ID, project name, as-of date and reporting interval in Setup.'],
 ['2 Baseline','Enter unique WBS IDs, units, approved baseline quantities and weights totaling 100%.'],
 ['3 Capture','Record Daily events once. Reported quantity and accepted quantity remain separate.'],
 ['4 Review','Enter actual reviewer identity, evidence and dates. A selected status is not a signature.'],
 ['5 Report','Report uses the selected interval; Dashboard uses the as-of date.'],
 ['6 Control','Use the registers, Evidence and History. Preserve prior issued revisions.'],
 ['Capacity','200 rows per register (rows7-206). Extend ALL formulas, validation and ranges before more rows.'],
 ['Input colors','Pale amber: editable. Pale green: calculated; do not overwrite.'],
 ['Privacy','Public source contains blank templates and synthetic examples only. Keep client copies private.'],
 ['Limits','Single-editor files. No automatic permission enforcement, conflict merging or legal certification.'],
 ['Sample mode',sample?'SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - not real work, payment or acceptance':'BLANK TEMPLATE - no real project loaded'],
 ['Help','Read IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md in this release folder.']
 ];
 start.getRange('A5:B18').values=guides;start.getRange('A5:A18').format.font={bold:true};start.getRange('B:B').format.columnWidth=98;
 const settings=[
 ['Project ID',sample?'DEMO-PH-001':null],
 ['Project name',sample?'Synthetic Cebu MEP Demonstration':null],
 ['As-of date',sample?new Date('2026-10-16T00:00:00Z'):null],
 ['Report start',sample?new Date('2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'):null],
 ['Report end',sample?new Date('2026-10-16T00:00:00Z'):null],
 ['Prepared by',sample?'Demo Site Engineer':null],
 ['Reviewed by',null],
 ['Issue revision',sample?1:null],
 ['Review / issue state','Draft'],
 ['Currency','PHP'],
 ['Jurisdiction','Philippines; project and contract rules require review'],
 ['Evidence custody',null]
 ];
 setup.getRange('A4:B15').values=settings;setup.getRange('B4:B15').format.fill='#FFFBEB';setup.getRange('B6:B8').setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd');setup.getRange('B:B').format.columnWidth=64;
 const w=sheets.WBS,d=sheets.Daily;
 rowFormula(w,'H',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",COUNTIFS(Daily!$C$7:$C$206,A'+r+',Daily!$B$7:$B$206,B'+r+',Daily!$I$7:$I$206,"Accepted",Daily!$P$7:$P$206,"Recorded - verify authority",Daily!$Q$7:$Q$206,"Matched",Daily!$R$7:$R$206,"Recorded",Daily!$M$7:$M$206,">0",Daily!$M$7:$M$206,"<="&Setup!$B$6,Daily!$D$7:$D$206,"<="&Setup!$B$6))');
 rowFormula(w,'I',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",IF(H'+r+'=0,"",SUMIFS(Daily!$H$7:$H$206,Daily!$C$7:$C$206,A'+r+',Daily!$B$7:$B$206,B'+r+',Daily!$I$7:$I$206,"Accepted",Daily!$P$7:$P$206,"Recorded - verify authority",Daily!$Q$7:$Q$206,"Matched",Daily!$R$7:$R$206,"Recorded",Daily!$M$7:$M$206,">0",Daily!$M$7:$M$206,"<="&Setup!$B$6,Daily!$D$7:$D$206,"<="&Setup!$B$6)))');
 rowFormula(w,'J',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",IF(OR(NOT(ISNUMBER(E'+r+')),E'+r+'<=0,I'+r+'=""),"",I'+r+'/E'+r+'))');
 rowFormula(w,'K',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",IF(OR(J'+r+'="",NOT(ISNUMBER(F'+r+'))),"",J'+r+'*F'+r+'))');
 rowFormula(w,'L',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",IF(OR(NOT(ISNUMBER(F'+r+')),NOT(ISNUMBER(G'+r+'))),"",F'+r+'*G'+r+'))');
 rowFormula(d,'P',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",IF(COUNTIFS($A$7:$A$206,A'+r+',$B$7:$B$206,B'+r+')<>1,"Duplicate event ID",IF(I'+r+'<>"Accepted","Review pending",IF(OR(J'+r+'="",L'+r+'="",NOT(ISNUMBER(M'+r+')),M'+r+'<=0,NOT(ISNUMBER(D'+r+')),D'+r+'<=0),"Missing approval evidence","Recorded - verify authority"))))');
 rowFormula(d,'Q',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",IF(COUNTIFS(WBS!$A$7:$A$206,C'+r+',WBS!$B$7:$B$206,B'+r+',WBS!$D$7:$D$206,F'+r+')=1,"Matched","Check WBS / unit"))');
 rowFormula(d,'R',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",IF(OR(NOT(ISNUMBER(G'+r+')),G'+r+'<0),"Check reported quantity",IF(I'+r+'="Accepted",IF(OR(NOT(ISNUMBER(H'+r+')),H'+r+'<0,H'+r+'>G'+r+'),"Check accepted quantity","Recorded"),"Not accepted")))');
 dash.getRange('A4:A15').values=[['Project'],['As-of date'],['Accepted weighted progress'],['Planned weighted progress'],['Variance (percentage points)'],['RFI overdue (not accepted/rejected)'],['Open issues'],['Open punch items'],['Turnover pending acceptance'],['WBS weight total'],['Progress basis'],['Evidence / quantity warnings']];
 formula(dash,'B4','=IF(Setup!B4="","No project selected",Setup!B4)');
 formula(dash,'B5','=IF(Setup!B6="","",Setup!B6)');dash.getRange('B5').setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd');
 rowFormula(w,'P',r=>'=IF(A'+r+'="","",IF(AND(COUNTIFS($A$7:$A$206,A'+r+',$B$7:$B$206,B'+r+')=1,B'+r+'=Setup!$B$4,D'+r+'<>"",ISNUMBER(E'+r+'),E'+r+'>0,ISNUMBER(F'+r+'),F'+r+'>=0,F'+r+'<=1,ISNUMBER(G'+r+'),G'+r+'>=0,G'+r+'<=1,O'+r+'<>""),"Valid","Review baseline / ID / weight"))');
 const valid='AND(COUNTIFS(WBS!$P$7:$P$206,"Valid")=COUNTA(WBS!$A$7:$A$206),Setup!$B$4<>"",ISNUMBER(Setup!$B$6),COUNT(WBS!$F$7:$F$206)=COUNTA(WBS!$A$7:$A$206),ABS(SUM(WBS!$F$7:$F$206)-1)<0.000001,COUNTA(WBS!$A$7:$A$206)>0)';
 formula(dash,'B6','=IF(AND('+valid+',COUNT(WBS!$K$7:$K$206)=COUNTA(WBS!$A$7:$A$206)),SUM(WBS!$K$7:$K$206),"n.a.")');
 formula(dash,'B7','=IF(AND('+valid+',COUNT(WBS!$L$7:$L$206)=COUNTA(WBS!$A$7:$A$206)),SUM(WBS!$L$7:$L$206),"n.a.")');
 formula(dash,'B8','=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(B6),ISNUMBER(B7)),B6-B7,"n.a.")');dash.getRange('B6:B8').setNumberFormat('0.0%');
 formula(dash,'B9','=IF(Setup!B6="","n.a.",COUNTIFS(RFI!$A$7:$A$206,"<>",RFI!$F$7:$F$206,">0",RFI!$F$7:$F$206,"<"&Setup!B6,RFI!$H$7:$H$206,"<>Accepted",RFI!$H$7:$H$206,"<>Rejected"))');
 formula(dash,'B10','=COUNTIFS(Issues!$A$7:$A$206,"<>",Issues!$J$7:$J$206,"<>Closed")');
 formula(dash,'B11','=COUNTIFS(Punch!$A$7:$A$206,"<>",Punch!$I$7:$I$206,"<>Closed")');
 formula(dash,'B12','=COUNTIFS(Turnover!$A$7:$A$206,"<>",Turnover!$I$7:$I$206,"<>Accepted")');
 formula(dash,'B13','=IF(COUNTA(WBS!A7:A206)=0,"n.a.",SUM(WBS!F7:F206))');dash.getRange('B13').setNumberFormat('0.0%');
 formula(dash,'B14','=IF('+valid+',"Review data and approvals","Missing project, date or complete 100% weights")');
 formula(dash,'B15','=COUNTIFS(Daily!$P$7:$P$206,"Duplicate event ID")+COUNTIFS(Daily!$A$7:$A$206,"<>",Daily!$P$7:$P$206,"Missing approval evidence")+COUNTIFS(Daily!$A$7:$A$206,"<>",Daily!$Q$7:$Q$206,"Check WBS / unit")+COUNTIFS(Daily!$A$7:$A$206,"<>",Daily!$R$7:$R$206,"Check*")');
 dash.getRange('A:A').format.columnWidth=42;dash.getRange('B:B').format.columnWidth=60;dash.getRange('A4:B15').format.rowHeight=26;
 set(dash,'A18','Progress is evidence-based recorded quantity, not certification, billability or payment.');
 dash.getRange('A18').format.font={italic:true,size:10,color:'#526660'};
 report.getRange('A4:F4').values=[['Project',null,'Start',null,'End',null]];formula(report,'B4','=IF(Setup!B4="","",Setup!B4)');formula(report,'D4','=IF(Setup!B7="","",Setup!B7)');formula(report,'F4','=IF(Setup!B8="","",Setup!B8)');report.getRange('D4:F4').setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd');report.getRange('D4:F4').format.horizontalAlignment='left';
 report.getRange('A6:H6').values=[['WBS ID','Activity','Unit','Reported in period','Accepted in period','Accepted to cutoff','Baseline quantity','Accepted fraction']];
 report.getRange('A6:H6').format={fill:'#173F35',font:{bold:true,color:'#FFFFFF'},wrapText:true,rowHeight:42,verticalAlignment:'center',horizontalAlignment:'center'};
 for(let r=first;r<=last;r++){
  for(const [c,f]of Object.entries({A:'=IF(WBS!A'+r+'="","",WBS!A'+r+')',B:'=IF(A'+r+'="","",WBS!C'+r+')',C:'=IF(A'+r+'="","",WBS!D'+r+')',
   D:'=IF(OR(A'+r+'="",Setup!$B$7="",Setup!$B$8="",Setup!$B$8<Setup!$B$7),"",SUMIFS(Daily!$G$7:$G$206,Daily!$Q$7:$Q$206,"Matched",Daily!$P$7:$P$206,"<>Duplicate event ID",Daily!$G$7:$G$206,">=0",Daily!$C$7:$C$206,A'+r+',Daily!$B$7:$B$206,Setup!$B$4,Daily!$D$7:$D$206,">="&Setup!$B$7,Daily!$D$7:$D$206,"<="&Setup!$B$8))',
   E:'=IF(OR(A'+r+'="",Setup!$B$7="",Setup!$B$8="",Setup!$B$8<Setup!$B$7),"",SUMIFS(Daily!$H$7:$H$206,Daily!$C$7:$C$206,A'+r+',Daily!$B$7:$B$206,Setup!$B$4,Daily!$I$7:$I$206,"Accepted",Daily!$P$7:$P$206,"Recorded - verify authority",Daily!$Q$7:$Q$206,"Matched",Daily!$R$7:$R$206,"Recorded",Daily!$M$7:$M$206,">0",Daily!$M$7:$M$206,"<="&Setup!$B$6,Daily!$D$7:$D$206,">="&Setup!$B$7,Daily!$D$7:$D$206,"<="&Setup!$B$8))',
   F:'=IF(A'+r+'="","",WBS!I'+r+')',G:'=IF(A'+r+'="","",WBS!E'+r+')',H:'=IF(A'+r+'="","",WBS!J'+r+')'}))formula(report,c+r,f);
 }

 wb.recalculate();return{wb,sheets,sample};
}
const blank=makeWorkbook(false),sample=makeWorkbook(true);
const cases=[];
function test(name,actual,expected){const pass=typeof expected==='number'?Math.abs(actual-expected)<1e-8:actual===expected;cases.push({name,actual,expected,pass});if(!pass)throw Error(name+': '+actual+' != '+expected);}
const cell=(b,s,c)=>b.sheets[s].getRange(c).values[0][0];
test('sample accepted weighted progress',cell(sample,'Dashboard','B6'),.35);
test('sample planned weighted progress',cell(sample,'Dashboard','B7'),.4);
test('sample variance',cell(sample,'Dashboard','B8'),-.05);
test('future event excluded from accepted quantity',cell(sample,'WBS','I7'),45);
test('period reported concrete quantity',cell(sample,'Report','D7'),50);
test('period accepted concrete quantity',cell(sample,'Report','E7'),45);
test('unreviewed pipe quantity excluded',cell(sample,'Report','E8'),40);
test('overdue RFI',cell(sample,'Dashboard','B9'),1);

// FileBlob exposes save(); use an OS named pipe to collect bytes in RAM without a disk artifact.
async function memoryBytes(file){
 const pipe='\\\\.\\pipe\\fdg-toolkit-'+process.pid+'-'+crypto.randomUUID();
 return await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const chunks=[];const server=net.createServer(c=>{c.on('data',x=>chunks.push(x));c.on('end',()=>server.close(()=>resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks))));c.on('error',reject);});
  server.on('error',reject);server.listen(pipe,()=>file.save(pipe).catch(e=>{server.close();reject(e);}));
 });
}
const rl=readline.createInterface({input:process.stdin,crlfDelay:Infinity});
for await(const line of rl){try{const cmd=JSON.parse(line);const b=cmd.mode==='blank'?blank:sample;
 if(cmd.op==='export'){const file=await SpreadsheetFile.exportXlsx(b.wb);const bytes=await memoryBytes(file);const imported=await SpreadsheetFile.importXlsx(bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength));imported.recalculate();const zip=await JSZip.loadAsync(bytes);const xml=await zip.file('xl/workbook.xml').async('string');const restored=imported.worksheets.getItem('Dashboard').getRange('B6').values[0][0];if(cmd.mode==='blank'?restored!=='n.a.':Math.abs(restored-.35)>1e-8)throw Error('Reimport progress mismatch');console.log(JSON.stringify({op:'export',mode:cmd.mode,bytes:bytes.length,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),reimportValue:imported.worksheets.getItem('Dashboard').getRange('B6').values[0][0],reimportInspection:(await imported.inspect({kind:'table',range:'Dashboard!A4:B15',include:'values,formulas',tableMaxRows:12,tableMaxCols:2,maxChars:5000})).ndjson,noMacros:!Object.keys(zip.files).some(x=>/vbaProject|externalLink/.test(x)),workbookXml:xml.slice(0,400),base64:bytes.toString('base64')}));}
 else if(cmd.op==='render'){const image=await b.wb.render({sheetName:cmd.sheet,range:cmd.range||'A1:H12',scale:1,format:'png'});console.log(JSON.stringify({op:'render',sheet:cmd.sheet,base64:Buffer.from(await image.arrayBuffer()).toString('base64')}));}
 else if(cmd.op==='inspect'){console.log(JSON.stringify({op:'inspect',result:await b.wb.inspect(cmd.options)}));}
 else if(cmd.op==='exit'){rl.close();break;}
 }catch(e){console.log(JSON.stringify({error:String(e),stack:e.stack?.split('\n').filter(x=>!x.includes('data:text/javascript')).slice(0,4)}));}}
project/build/package-toolkit.mjs
import {createRequire} from 'node:module';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
const require=createRequire((process.env.FDG_NODE_MODULES||process.cwd()+'/node_modules')+'/fdg-package.cjs');
const JSZip=require('jszip');
export async function packageToolkit(input){
 const files={};for(const [path,entry] of Object.entries(input.files)){
  if(path.startsWith('/')||path.split('/').includes('..'))throw Error('Unsafe package path');
  files[path]=Buffer.from(entry.content,entry.encoding==='base64'?'base64':'utf8');
 }
 const checks=[];
 function assert(name,condition,detail){checks.push({name,pass:!!condition,detail});if(!condition)throw Error(name);}
 const schema=JSON.parse(files['schema/toolkit-schema.json'].toString());
 assert('thirteen register schemas',schema.registers.length===13);
 assert('eleven printable forms',(files['forms.html'].toString().match(/class="page"/g)||[]).length===11);
 assert('forms have no external resources',!/<(?:script|link)|(?:src)=/i.test(files['forms.html'].toString()));
 for(const d of schema.registers){
  const headers=d.fields.filter(k=>!(d.computed||[]).includes(k));
  for(const mode of ['blank','sample']){
   const data=files['csv/'+mode+'/'+d.sheet+'.csv'].toString();
   assert(mode+' CSV schema '+d.sheet,data.split(/\r?\n/)[0]===headers.join(','));
  }
 }
 for(const name of ['FDG-CMT-PH-Blank.xlsx','FDG-CMT-PH-Worked-Example.xlsx']){
  const z=await JSZip.loadAsync(files[name],{checkCRC32:true});
  const paths=Object.keys(z.files),workbook=await z.file('xl/workbook.xml').async('string');
  assert(name+' seventeen sheets',(workbook.match(/<\w*:sheet\s/g)||[]).length===17);
  assert(name+' thirteen tables',paths.filter(p=>/^xl\/tables\/[^/]+\.xml$/.test(p)).length===13);
  assert(name+' no macros or external links',!paths.some(p=>/vbaProject|externalLink/.test(p)));
  let formulas=0,validations=0,errors=0;
  for(const p of paths.filter(p=>/^xl\/worksheets\/sheet\d+\.xml$/.test(p))){
   const xml=await z.file(p).async('string');
   formulas+=(xml.match(/<(?:\w+:)?f[ >]/g)||[]).length;
   validations+=(xml.match(/<(?:\w+:)?dataValidation\s/g)||[]).length;
   errors+=(xml.match(/\bt="e"/g)||[]).length;
  }
  assert(name+' formula cells retained',formulas>=3400,{formulas});
  assert(name+' dropdown validation retained',validations>=10,{validations});
  assert(name+' no cached Excel errors',errors===0,{errors});
 }
 const manifest={product:'FDG Construction Management Professional Toolkit — Philippines Edition',version:schema.version,source_baseline:'91c6fc7346ace8dbf2f7ec86880c6e4b24c2289b',status:'Review candidate; native application and user acceptance pending',files:Object.entries(files).sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b)).map(([path,bytes])=>({path,bytes:bytes.length,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex')}))};
 files['MANIFEST.json']=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2)+'\n');
 const zip=new JSZip();for(const [path,bytes]of Object.entries(files))zip.file(path,bytes,{date:new Date('2026-10-16T00:00:00Z')});
 const bytes=await zip.generateAsync({type:'nodebuffer',compression:'DEFLATE'});
 const restored=await JSZip.loadAsync(bytes,{checkCRC32:true});
 for(const entry of manifest.files){const b=await restored.file(entry.path).async('nodebuffer');assert('ZIP integrity '+entry.path,crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex')===entry.sha256);}
 return {checks,manifest,zip:{bytes:bytes.length,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),base64:bytes.toString('base64')},fileCount:Object.keys(files).length};
}
if(process.env.FDG_PACKAGE_STDIN==='1'){let input='';for await(const chunk of process.stdin)input+=chunk;console.log(JSON.stringify(await packageToolkit(JSON.parse(input))));}
